<slate title="Limits">
  <column id="root">
    <section id="context" title="Thread context">
      <row id="context-head" between>
        <text
          id="context-used"
          tone={thread.context.percent > 80 ? 'warning' : 'default'}
          placeholder="No context reported yet."
        >
          {pct(thread.context.percent)} used
        </text>
        <text id="context-free" muted mono>
          {tokens(thread.context.free)} free of {tokens(thread.context.window)}
        </text>
      </row>
      <meter
        id="context-meter"
        tokens
        label="Context"
        value={thread.context.used}
        max={thread.context.window}
        tone={thread.context.percent > 80 ? 'warning' : 'default'}
      />
    </section>
    <section id="plan" title="Plan usage">
      <column id="windows" tight>
        <meter
          id="session"
          label="5 hour"
          value={usage.session.percent}
          note={`resets ${until(usage.session.resetsAt)}`}
          tone={usage.session.percent > 80 ? 'warning' : 'default'}
        />
        <meter
          id="week"
          label="Weekly"
          value={usage.week.percent}
          note={`resets ${until(usage.week.resetsAt)}, ${weekday(usage.week.resetsAt)}`}
          tone={usage.week.percent > 80 ? 'warning' : 'default'}
        />
      </column>
      <text id="usage-note" muted small when={exists(usage.note)}>
        {usage.note}
      </text>
    </section>
  </column>
</slate>
